question: Limbs of the puppets are loosely-jointed:

options.text: to create the illusion of dancing
to allow movement of limbs separately
to move the entire body of the puppet

solution:
​The correct answer is "**to allow movement of limbs separately**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **theme **of the given comprehension is about **puppetry **and how it evolved as an art form, It can be a medium of communication as well as a source of entertainment for young and old alike.
 
• In the **third **paragraph of the given comprehension, it is stated that limbs are loosely-jointed so that they can be made to move separately

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**
